title: Establishing a preoperative predictive model for gallbladder adenoma and cholesterol polyps based on machine learning: a multicentre retrospective study.
summary: A multicenter model distinguishes pathology-confirmed gallbladder adenomas from cholesterol polyps, with a primary cohort of 1,009 patients (706 training, 303 internal) plus 139 external cases; 12 algorithms in 110 combinations were compared, and SVM with random forest reached AUC 0.972 internally and 0.922 externally. Diagnoses came from postoperative pathology. A publisher correction changes the funding acknowledgement only, not the result.
